All 14 queries ran and gave the expected answers on the sample files. Results:

- **H1:** `["Alice" "Gita" "Zed"]`
- **H2:** 69.23
- **H3:** `{"acme":3,"globex":2,"initech":2}`
- **H4:** `{"name":"demo-app","depCount":3,"devDepCount":2,"scripts":["build","lint","start","test"]}`
- **H5:** `[102 104 106]`
- **H6:** `["bug" "docs" "feature" "p1" "perf" "tests"]`
- **H7:** `{"mia":2,"unassigned":2,"leo":1,"noa":1}`
- **H8:** `{:auth 2 :billing 2 :search 1}`
- **H9:** `["bob" "carol" "dave" "erin"]`
- **H10:** `{:eu 62.8 :us 50.5 :ap 20}`
- **H11:** `{:host "localhost" :port "5432" :name "main" :ssl "false"}`
- **H12:** `[{"name":"api","timeout":30,"team":"core"},{"name":"auth","timeout":0,"team":"none"},{"name":"cron","timeout":30,"team":"none"},{"name":"web","timeout":10,"team":"front"}]`
- **H13:** `["Cy Roy: ","Ann Lee: a|b","Flo Day: q","Bo Ng: "]`
- **H14:** `[{:word "dog" :count 3} {:word "the" :count 3} {:word "a" :count 2}]`

A few things to know before you reuse these:

- **Rounding:** qlang has no rounding verb, so H2 and H10 round through the number's printed text. Multiply by the scale, add 0.5, print, keep what is before the ".", read it back as a number, then divide. This rounds half up and assumes positive values.
- **H8:** it needs `qlang --raw` because it reads `access.log` as text.
- **H9:** it needs `qlang --raw` because it reads `access.log` as text.
- **H10:** it needs `qlang --raw` because it reads `servers.csv` as text.
- **H11:** it needs `qlang --raw` because it reads `settings.env` as text.
- **H14:** it strips punctuation only for `; , . !`, which covers this text but is not a general "letters only" split.

H1: `filter ~(coalesce ~(cond ~(/active | eq true) ~(cond ~(/country | upper | eq "DE") ~(cond ~(/age | type | eq ::number) ~(/age | gte 30) ~(false)) ~(false)) ~(false)) ~(false)) * /name | sort`
H2: `filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") * (/items * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum | mul 100 | add 0.5 | print | split "." | first | parseJson | div 100`
H3: `groupBy ~(/customer | lower) * count`
H4: `{:name /name :depCount (/dependencies | count) :devDepCount (/devDependencies | count) :scripts (/scripts | keys * keyword | sort)}`
H5: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | mul -1) /id]) | take 3 * /id`
H6: `* (coalesce ~(/labels) ~([])) | flat | * lower | distinct | sort`
H7: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(coalesce ~(/assignee/login) ~("unassigned")) * count`
H8: `lines | * split " " | filter ~(coalesce ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") ~(false)) | groupBy ~(/2) * count`
H9: `lines | * split " " | filter ~(coalesce ~(/1 | cond ~(eq "ERROR") ~(true) ~(eq "WARN") ~(true) ~(false)) ~(false)) * (drop 3 | filter ~(startsWith "user=") * (split "=" | /1)) | flat | distinct | sort`
H10: `lines | drop 1 | * split "," | filter ~(coalesce ~(cond ~(/4 | lower | eq "up") ~(/2 | eq "" | eq false) ~(false)) ~(false)) | groupBy ~(/1) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | :v / | v | sum | div (v | count) | mul 10 | add 0.5 | print | split "." | first | parseJson | div 10)`
H11: `lines | filter ~(startsWith "#" | eq false) | filter ~(contains "=") | * (split "=" | {:k (/0 | lower) :v (drop 1 | join "=")}) | filter ~(/k | startsWith "db_") | * {:k (/k | split "_" | drop 1 | join "_") :v /v} | indexBy ~(/k) * /v`
H12: `:cfg / | /services | filter ~(/enabled | eq true) | sort ~(/name) * {:name /name :timeout (coalesce ~(/timeout) ~(cfg | /defaults/timeout)) :team (coalesce ~(/owner/team) ~("none"))}`
H13: `/results | filter ~(coalesce ~(cond ~(/score | type | eq ::number) ~(/score | gte 50) ~(false)) ~(false)) | sort ~(/score | mul -1) * ([/profile/first " " /profile/last ": " (coalesce ~(/tags) ~([]) | join "|")] | join "")`
H14: `"The cat saw the dog; a Dog saw THE cat and a bird. Bird, dog!" | lower | split " " | * (split ";" | join "") | * (split "," | join "") | * (split "." | join "") | * (split "!" | join "") | :w / | distinct * (:x / | {:word x :count (w | filter ~(eq x) | count)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word]) | take 3`
